source_receipt.review_basis: authored visual review of the archived page-22 equipment matrix

decisions.rationale: This complete row preserves manual air conditioning as standard in Essential and unavailable in Expression, Journey and Extreme.

decisions.row_context: first line of the dual-zone automatic-climate row with rear vents
decisions.rationale: This is the first line of one three-line visual row: automatic climate control, dual-zone operation and rear vents are unavailable in Essential and standard in the other trims. The three attributes remain distinct.
This complete row preserves electrically folding mirrors as unavailable in Essential and standard in all higher trims.

decisions.row_context: first line of the centre-console-with-armrest-and-storage row
decisions.rationale: This is the first line of the Expression centre-console row. Essential has a low console, while Journey and Extreme use the separate high-console row; the variants are not merged.
This complete row preserves wireless charging as unavailable in Essential and Expression and standard in Journey and Extreme.

decisions.row_context: final line of the Winter package row
decisions.rationale: This fragment closes the Winter package row. The heated steering wheel is unavailable in Essential and optional or package-bound in the other trims; it is not promoted to standard.

decisions.row_context: final line of the Winter Plus package row
decisions.rationale: This fragment closes the Winter Plus package row. The heated windscreen is unavailable in Essential and optional or package-bound in the other trims; it is not promoted to standard.
